title: useSpaceState
description: `useSpaceState` notes the last page of the page's space on each address, in `lathe:space-pages`.

title: usePageTabs
description: `usePageTabs` moves the active tab with `moveInTab` on each address it did not set itself.

title: usePageTabs.change
description: `change` in `usePageTabs` moves the address to the active tab's after an activate, a new tab or a close, and rewrites the window's history to that tab's entries (app/src/views/tabHistory.ts).

title: stopServer
description: `stopServer`, from the closed, before-quit, SIGINT and SIGTERM handlers that stop servers.
